snippet.title: The Keeper: Uncover the mystery of a haunted lighthouse and the ghostly apparitions residing within!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://comp3interactive.itch.io/the-keeper?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Waking up on your fishing boat after a night out at sea you realise it must be time to head on home, but the return journey is not as it seems.

Landing on a lonely island populated by only a lighthouse, you must uncover the mystery and find your escape from this vacant place.
